scope: Qualified CPU movement audit across all 44 production scenes and 122 levels. No application changes, browser link UI events, complete route or physical-phone certification.

doorApertures.method: Straight local cross-section geometry of the 28 failed canWalk door probes; positive collinear overlap confirms another blocking wall on the opened aperture, not complete route analysis.

authoredLinkEndpoints.method: Every authored vertical link endpoint, current grid plus room floor, actual canWalk/moveBlockers with doors in authored default state. Try eight nearby 2.5-ft offsets until one is allowed. Distances measure polygon edge geometry; points exactly on edges may fail pointInPolygon but have zero outside distance. Exclude lattices over one million nodes. Does not fire UI link transitions, prove end-to-end routes, or decide canonical landing positions.

snappedLinkArrivals.method: Every vertical link arrival snapped through the same squareCellCenter(squareCellAt(pos)) used by App.afterPartyMove, current grid plus room floor, actual canWalk/moveBlockers with doors in authored default state. Try eight nearby 2.5-ft offsets until one is allowed. Distances measure polygon edge geometry; points exactly on edges may fail pointInPolygon but have zero outside distance. Exclude lattices over one million nodes. Does not fire UI link transitions, prove end-to-end routes, or decide canonical landing positions.

isolatedLinkTransitions.method: Executed exact committed App.takeLink and App.afterPartyMove bodies after TypeScript stripping, with actual grid functions. Harness stubs rendering, status, persistence and reveal side effects; captures level transitions for every link in both directions. This proves isolated transition logic, not browser/UI visibility or complete gameplay.

interpretation: A nearby move pass is not a complete route. Off-floor arrivals at an elevator or shaft can represent a deliberate void and need source interpretation. Wrong destination and multiple-hop counts reproduce existing queued transition behavior; they do not authorize fixing item 11 in this release.
